acceptance_criteria.description: Saved Test 6 profile/eigenmode hashes match exactly; finer h=.025 uses documented natural cubic interpolation of the frozen h=.05 data, no calibration fit.
Surface, reconstructed inputs, calibration and all prediction hashes verify; all prediction locks precede the first nonlinear receiver-start event.
For nominal single, second, both and changed-phase interval records on h=.025, |delta_N| > 5*(|finer-fine|+|base-time|+|base-wide|+1e-11 cycles). Otherwise unresolved.

Fine-grid (h=.025) local chi trace prediction relative L2 error <= max(5%, direct mesh+time+box L2 error plus 1e-13 m/sample floor, divided by signal norm), for single, second, both and phase controls.

For each selected local interval, standalone precomputed marker/phase record differs by <= max(5% of actual interval record, its registered absolute error budget). If interval not resolved, unresolved.

Every nonquiet case on every grid has a first rising and subsequent last falling |a|=1e-4 local crossing in t=0..100; predicted marker times within 0.1 m^-1 of observed events. Quiet has no neutral markers and is only a matched counterfactual reference.
Single and pair sign-odd/even local trace norm ratio <1e-5 on every grid.
A=.002,.004,.008 amplitude-normalized single-pulse trace differences <5%; weak log slope within 0.1 of two on every grid.
Both-minus-each-alone chi trace is >5 times direct mesh+time+box+1e-13 m/sample budget and its predicted residual <=max(5%, inverse signal/error ratio); otherwise unresolved.
Executed incomplete Taylor replay gives max absolute delta_chi2 and delta_chi_dot2 <1e-15, while full single response RMS >5e-13 m.
Each relative chi response L2 difference (fine/base, time/base, wide/base, finer/fine) <5% in single, second, both and phase controls.
Maximum charge relative error <1e-5 and matched discrete energy residual/initial incident energy <1% for every grid and nonquiet case.

summary.marker_definition: first rising and last falling |a|=1e-4 at r=0.1 in t=0..100; matched quiet phase sampled at these counterfactual local times

known_gaps: Flat spherical receiver; opposite radial directions arise by central reflection.
No two-object recoil, observer transformation, or autonomous Candidate A clock.
Quiet comparison at pulse marker events is a counterfactual local diagnostic, not quiet-pulse detection.
The additional mesh interpolates the frozen fine calibration; no new branch fit.
Surface acquisition is a first-order neutral calculation, not an experimental measurement.
